audit_items.proof_trace: The signing.ComputeForkDigest function computes fork digest using only fork version and genesis validators root, without incorporating blob parameters. This diverges from params.ForkDigest which correctly XORs blob parameters (config.go:586-589) for Fulu+ epochs. The bootnode (bootnode.go:221) uses signing.ComputeForkDigest to create ENR fork IDs, producing digests that lack blob parameter information.
audit_items.attack_scenario: When blob parameters change in a Fulu BPO (blob-parameters-only) fork while fork version remains constant, bootnodes using signing.ComputeForkDigest will advertise incorrect fork digests in their ENR records. Regular nodes computing params.ForkDigest with blob parameter XOR will reject these bootnodes due to digest mismatch (fork.go:57-63), causing network partition between updated and non-updated bootnodes.
